name: tract_developer_decline
description: Test 18, by hand from 4.19. Residential developer (purpose 1, wealth 1), tract (0, 0) of 4 x 4 cells. A 2 x 1 lot (location (1, 0), facing 0 -> cells (0, 0) and (1, 0)) in state 3 for 90 days, building 0x200 of purpose 1, occupant wealth 1, capacity 12. The prime-step iterator's Reset(true) makes one rand() (CRT state 1 -> 2745024, rand() = 41, 41 mod 16 = 9, recorded as R8 with the start index); the lot is visited once per cell, but after the first AbandonBuilding(L, 6) its state is 4, so it is counted once: returns 12, one abandon. Second call with a fresh lot at 59 days: nothing qualifies, returns 0, and the next rand() (18467 mod 16 = 3) is still consumed. Third call: lots that fail one condition each (state 2; wealth 2; building of purpose 2; no building) are not abandoned; a qualifying lot at exactly 60 days is (unsigned >= 60). One rand() per call (third rand() 6334 mod 16 = 14).
